verses.en: The same day went Jesus out of the house, and sat by the sea side.
verses.sm: Iesu i le motu o tagata O lea lava aso ua ulufafo ai lesu nai le fale, ua nofo i lalo e latalata ane i le vai;

verses.en: And great multitudes were gathered together unto him, so that he went into a ship, and sat; and the whole multitude stood on the shore.
verses.sm: ona faapotopoto mai ai lea ia te ia o le motu o tagata e toatele, o le tea foi outou, a e tou te le iloa. Aud lea na maliu ae ai o ia i le vaa, ua nofo ai; ua tutu mai foi le motu o tagata uma i le auvai.

verses.en: And he spake many things unto them in parables, saying, Behold, a sower went forth to sow;
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i latou i mea e tele i faataoto, ua faapea atu, “Faauta, ua alu atu le tagata lulu saito e lulu ai saito.

verses.en: And when he sowed, some seeds fell by the way side, and the fowls came and devoured them up:
verses.sm: Ua ia lulu saito, ua paù ai isi i le auala; ona o ane lea o manu felelei, ma aai ai.

verses.en: Some fell upon stony places, where they had not much earth: and forthwith they sprung up, because they had no deepness of earth:
verses.sm: Ua paù foi isi i le mea papa, e itiiti le eleele sa i ai; ona vave tupu ai lea, ona o le eleele ina itiiti;

verses.en: And when the sun was up, they were scorched; and because they had no root, they withered away.
verses.sm: ua alu ae le la, ua velasia; ona magumagu ai lea, ona ua leai ni aa.

verses.en: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprung up, and choked them:
verses.sm: Ua pau foi isi i le vao tuitui, ua tutupu ae foi le vao tuitui, ona fetinaiina ai lea.

verses.en: But other fell into good ground, and brought forth fruit, some an hundredfold, some sixtyfold, some thirtyfold.
verses.sm: A ua pau isi i le eleele lelei, ona fua mai ai lea e taiselau i nisi ma taionogafulu i nisi ma taitolugafulu i nisi.

verses.en: Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.sm: O le ua i ai taliga, ina faalogo mai ia o ia.”

verses.en: And the disciples came, and said unto him, Why speakest thou unto them in parables?
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea o ona soo, ua faapea mai ia te ia, “Se a le mea ua e fetalai atu ai ia te i latou i faataoto?”

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.
verses.sm: Ona tali atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, “Ua foaiina atu ia te outou ia outou iloa mea lilo o le malo o .e lagi, a ua le foaiina atu ia te i latou.

verses.en: For whosoever hath, to him shall be given, and he shall have more abundance: but whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken away even that he hath.
verses.sm: Aua o le ua i ai mea, e foaiina atu ia te ia, e atili tele ai ana mea; a o se le i ai mea, e aveeseina foi ia te ia le mea ua ia te ia.

verses.en: Therefore speak I to them in parables: because they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.
verses.sm: O le mea lea ou te tautala atu ai ia te i latou i faataoto, aua o lo latou vaai latou te le vaai ai, o lo latou faalogo foi, latou te le faalogo ai, pe lagona.

verses.en: And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Esaias, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive:
verses.sm: Ua taunuu ai ia te i latou le valoaga a Isaia, ua faapea mai, E faalogo lava outou, a e tou te le lagona; e matud vaavaai ua mafiafia loto o lenei nuu,

verses.en: For this people's heart is waxed gross, and their ears are dull of hearing, and their eyes they have closed; lest at any time they should see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and should understand with their heart, and should be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.sm: ma ua faalogo gata o latou taliga i faalogo, ua moetini foi o latou mata; ne'i vaai o latou mata, ma faalogo o latou taliga, ma lagona o latou loto, ma liliuina i latou, ma ou faamaloloina i latou.

verses.en: But blessed are your eyes, for they see: and your ears, for they hear.
verses.sm: Amuia o outou mata, aua ua vaavaai; ma o outou taliga, aua ua faalogo;

verses.en: For verily I say unto you, That many prophets and righteous men have desired to see those things which ye see, and have not seen them; and to hear those things which ye hear, and have not heard them.
verses.sm: aua e moni, ou te fai atu ia te outou, E toatele perofeta ma tagata amiotonu sa naunau i le fia iloa o mea ua outou vaai i ai, a e lei iloa; na latou fia faalogo foi i mea ua outou faalogo i ai, a e lei faalogo ai lava.

verses.en: Hear ye therefore the parable of the sower.
verses.sm: “O lenei, ina faalogologo mai ia outou i le faataoto i le tagata lulu saito.

verses.en: When any one heareth the word of the kingdom, and understandeth it not, then cometh the wicked one, and catcheth away that which was sown in his heart. This is he which received seed by the way side.
verses.sm: A faalogo se tasi i le upu o le malo, a e le lagona, ona alu ane ai lea o le ua leaga, ua fao le mea sa luluina i lona loto; o le mea lea sa luluina i le auala.

verses.en: But he that received the seed into stony places, the same is he that heareth the word, and anon with joy receiveth it;
verses.sm: A o le mea sa luluina i le mea papa, o le tagata lea ua faalogo i le upu, ona talia loa lea ma le fiafia;

verses.en: Yet hath he not root in himself, but dureth for a while: for when tribulation or persecution ariseth because of the word, by and by he is offended.
verses.sm: a ua leai ni aa ia te ia, ua faaletumau ia; aua pe a tupu le puapuaga, po o le sauaga ona o le upu, ona tausuai loa lea o ia.

verses.en: He also that received seed among the thorns is he that heareth the word; and the care of this world, and the deceitfulness of riches, choke the word, and he becometh unfruitful.
verses.sm: O le mea sa luluina i le vao tuitui, o ia lea ua faalogo i le upu, a o le loto popole i mea a lenei lalolagi, ma le pepelo o le oa ua fetinaiina ai le upu, ona le fua mai lava lea.

verses.en: But he that received seed into the good ground is he that heareth the word, and understandeth it; which also beareth fruit, and bringeth forth, some an hundredfold, some sixty, some thirty.
verses.sm: A o le mea sa luluina i le eleele lelei, o ia lea ua faalogo i le upu, ma lagona ai; ua fua mai lava ia, e taiselau i nisi, e taionogafulu i nisi, e taitolugafulu foi i nisi.”

verses.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is likened unto a man which sowed good seed in his field:
verses.sm: Ua sauni atu e ia le tasi faataoto la te i latou, ua faapea atu, “Ua faatusaina le malo o le lagi i le tagata na luluina le saito lelei i lona fanua;

verses.en: But while men slept, his enemy came and sowed tares among the wheat, and went his way.
verses.sm: ua momoe tagata, ona alu ane ai lea o le ua ita mai ia te ia, ua na luluina le titania i totonu o le saito, ona alu ese ai lea o 1a.

verses.en: But when the blade was sprung up, and brought forth fruit, then appeared the tares also.
verses.sm: Ua totogo ae le saito, ma fua mai, ona iloa ai lea o le titania.

verses.en: So the servants of the householder came and said unto him, Sir, didst not thou sow good seed in thy field? from whence then hath it tares?
verses.sm: Ona o mai ai lea o auauna a le matai o le aiga, ua faapea mai ia te ia, Le alii e, e leo le saito lelei ea na e luluina i lou fanua? O lenei, pe naifea nei titania?

verses.en: He said unto them, An enemy hath done this. The servants said unto him, Wilt thou then that we go and gather them up?
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o ia ia te i latou, Ua fai lenei mea e se tagata ua ita mai. Ona fai mai ai lea o auauna ia te ia, E te finagalo ea matou te o atu e veleeseina ia mea?

verses.en: But he said, Nay; lest while ye gather up the tares, ye root up also the wheat with them.
verses.sm: A ua fai atu ia, Aua; ina ne“ outou liai ma le saito pe a outou vele ese le titania.

verses.en: Let both grow together until the harvest: and in the time of harvest I will say to the reapers, Gather ye together first the tares, and bind them in bundles to burn them: but gather the wheat into my barn.
verses.sm: Tuu ia, ia tupu lua pea seia 00 i le seleselega; a 00 atu i ona po E selesele ai, ou te fai atu ai i e selesele, Ia outou muai faapotopoto mai le titania, ma outou fusia i fusi e susunu ai; a o le saito, tou te faaputuina lea i loʻu fale saito.”

verses.en: Another parable put he forth unto them, saying, The kingdom of heaven is like to a grain of mustard seed, which a man took, and sowed in his field:
verses.sm: Ua sauni atu e ia le tasi faataoto ia te i latou, ua faapea atu, “E tusa le malo o le lagi ma le fua o le sinapi, na ave e le tasi tagata, ma toto i lona fanua;

verses.en: Which indeed is the least of all seeds: but when it is grown, it is the greatest among herbs, and becometh a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in the branches thereof.
verses.sm: e itiiti lava ia i fua o laau uma; pe a uma ona tupu, E sili ia i laau afu, e iu ina fai ma laau tele, e o mai ai manu felelei, ma latou momoe i ona la.”

verses.en: Another parable spake he unto them; The kingdom of heaven is like unto leaven, which a woman took, and hid in three measures of meal, till the whole was leavened.
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu e ia le tasi faataoto ia te i latou, “E tusa le malo o le lagi ma le mea faafefete, na ave e le fafine, ma tuu i totonu o le falaoa mata pe tusa ma le ono sefulu pauna, ua oo ina faafefeteina uma ai.”

verses.en: All these things spake Jesus unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:
verses.sm: Ua fetalai atu Iesu ia mea uma i le motu o tagata i faataoto, ua na O faataoto na fetalai atu ai o ia ia te i latou:

verses.en: That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.
verses.sm: ina ia taunuu ai o le upu a le perofeta, ua faapea mai, Ou te tautala atu i faataoto, ou te tau atu mea na lilo talu ona faavaeina o le lalolagi.

verses.en: Then Jesus sent the multitude away, and went into the house: and his disciples came unto him, saying, Declare unto us the parable of the tares of the field.
verses.sm: Ona tuuna ai lea e Iesu o le motu o tagata, ua ulufale atu ai i le fale; ona o mai ai lea ia te ia o ona soo, ua faapea mai, “Ia e faamatala mai ia te i matou le faataoto i le titania i le fanua.”

verses.en: He answered and said unto them, He that soweth the good seed is the Son of man;
verses.sm: Ona tali atu ai lea o ia, “O lè lulu le saito lelei, o le Atalii lea o le tagata;

verses.en: The field is the world; the good seed are the children of the kingdom; but the tares are the children of the wicked one;
verses.sm: a o le fanua, o le lalolagi lea; o le saito lelei, o tagata ia o le malo; o le titania, o le fanau ia a le ua leaga;

verses.en: The enemy that sowed them is the devil; the harvest is the end of the world; and the reapers are the angels.
verses.sm: O le ua ita mai na na luluina ia mea, O le tiapolo lea; o le seleselega, o le gataaga lea o le lalolagi; o e selesele, o agelu ia.

verses.en: As therefore the tares are gathered and burned in the fire; so shall it be in the end of this world.
verses.sm: O lea e pei ona faaputuina ai o le titania, ma susunuina i le afi, e faapea foi ona faia i le gataaga o lenei Jalolagi.

verses.en: The Son of man shall send forth his angels, and they shall gather out of his kingdom all things that offend, and them which do iniquity;
verses.sm: E aauina atu e le Atalii o le tagata ana agelu, latou te faapotopotoina nai lona malo mea uma e tausuai ai ma E amio leaga.

verses.en: And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.sm: E lafoina i latou i totonu o le ogàumu aasa; e i ai le tagiaue ma le lilivau o nifo.

verses.en: Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.
verses.sm: Ona pupula ai lea O e amiotonu e pei o le la i le malo o lo latou Tama. O le ua i ai taliga, ina faalogo mai ia o ia.

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto treasure hid in a field; the which when a man hath found, he hideth, and for joy thereof goeth and selleth all that he hath, and buyeth that field.
verses.sm: “E tusa foi le malo o le lagi i le oa ua natia i le fanua; ua iloa e le tasi, ona nana ai lea e ia; ua alu foi ma le fiafia, ma faatau atu ana mea uma, i le faatau a“ mai lea fanua.

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a merchant man, seeking goodly pearls:
verses.sm: “E tusa foi le malo o le lagi ma le tagata faatauoa, ua sailijli penina lelei;

verses.en: Who, when he had found one pearl of great price, went and sold all that he had, and bought it.
verses.sm: ua iloa e ia le tasi penina tau tele, ona alu ai lea o ia, ua faatau atu ana mea uma, i le faatau a“ mai.

verses.en: Again, the kingdom of heaven is like unto a net, that was cast into the sea, and gathered of every kind:
verses.sm: “E tusa foi le malo o le lagi ma le upega ua lafo i le vai, ua maua ai ifa eseese uma.

verses.en: Which, when it was full, they drew to shore, and sat down, and gathered the good into vessels, but cast the bad away.
verses.sm: Ua tumu, ona latou toso ae ai lea i le matafaga, ua nonofo ma fafao iʻa lelei i ola, a o iʻa leaga ua lafoai.

verses.en: So shall it be at the end of the world: the angels shall come forth, and sever the wicked from among the just,
verses.sm: E faapea foi i 12 gataaga o le lalolagi; e o atu le au agelu e vavae ese i e amio leaga ma e amiotonu,

verses.en: And shall cast them into the furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth.
verses.sm: ona latou lafoina lea ia te i latou i le ogaumu aasa; e i ai le tagiaue ma le lilivau o nifo.”

verses.en: Jesus saith unto them, Have ye understood all these things? They say unto him, Yea, Lord.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o Iesu ia te i latou, “Ua outou lagona ea nei mea uma?” Ua latou fai mai ia te ia, “Ioe.”

verses.en: Then said he unto them, Therefore every scribe which is instructed unto the kingdom of heaven is like unto a man that is an householder, which bringeth forth out of his treasure things new and old.
verses.sm: Ona fetalai atu lea o ia ia te i atou, “O lenei, o tusiupu uma o e ua aʻoaʻoina i le malo o le lagi, e tusa i latou ma le matai o le aiga, ua au mai mca fou ma mea tuai mai lona tuugaoloa.”

verses.en: And it came to pass, that when Jesus had finished these parables, he departed thence.
verses.sm: Ua faaiu e Iesu nei faataoto, ona maliu ese ai lea o ia i lea mea.

verses.en: And when he was come into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, insomuch that they were astonished, and said, Whence hath this man this wisdom, and these mighty works?
verses.sm: Ua oo atu ia i lona lava nuu, ona aʻoaʻo atu ai lea o ia ia tei latou i lo latou sur.ako; ua latou taufaiofo ai, ua faapea ane, “Po o fea na maua ai e lenci tagata lenei poto ma ia vavega?

verses.en: Is not this the carpenter's son? is not his mother called Mary? and his brethren, James, and Joses, and Simon, and Judas?
verses.sm: E le o le atalii ca lenei o le tufuga? E le o Maria ea le igoa o lona tina, o ona uso foi o Iakopo, ma Ioscfa, ma Simona, ma Iuta?

verses.en: And his sisters, are they not all with us? Whence then hath this man all these things?
verses.sm: E le o ia te i tatou ea ona tuafàfine uma? Po o fea foi na maua ai e lenei tagata nei mea uma?”

verses.en: And they were offended in him. But Jesus said unto them, A prophet is not without honour, save in his own country, and in his own house.
verses.sm: Ona latou tausuai ai lea ia te ia. A ua fetalai atu Iesu ia te i latou, “E leai se perofeta e le mamalu, ua na o lona lava nuu ma lona aiga c le mamalu ai.”

verses.en: And he did not many mighty works there because of their unbelief.
verses.sm: Ua le tele foi ni vavega na na faia i lea mea, ona o lo latou le faatuatua.
